newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finns more upbeat on 97 than many Europeans - paper.
newsitem.headline: Finns more upbeat on 97 than many Europeans - paper.

text.p: Finns are more hopeful about the new year in general than most other Europeans, the daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Thursday.
It quoted a Suomen Gallup opinion poll which showed that 39 percent of 1,000 Finns surveyed expected 1997 to be a better year than 1996 while 11 percent expected it to be worse.
Citizens in most other European countries were less optimistic in similar surveys but in Britain, Denmark, Ireland, Bosnia, Norway and Estonia, more people expected a better 1997, the paper said.
Belgium and Italy matched Finland's 39 percent, it said.
